final: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM per_patient), ratios AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / total_count AS ratio FROM per_patient CROSS JOIN overall), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT ratios.ID, ratios.record_count, ratios.ratio, ratios.ratio - average_ratio.avg_ratio AS difference FROM ratios CROSS JOIN average_ratio WHERE ratios.ratio > average_ratio.avg_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
